key_insight: The paper builds the first large spin-polarized electronic-structure database for stable halide double perovskites, revealing many compounds with visible-range band gaps and a notable subset with half-metallic behavior.
engineering_relevance: This dataset accelerates materials screening for solar cells, photocatalysis, and spintronic devices by linking composition to electronic and magnetic properties.
method: Spin-polarized density of states and band-gap analysis
Lobster bonding analysis plus UMAP visualization and an interactive app
evidence_signal: The abstract reports >2,500 calculated compounds, 719 with visible-range band gaps, and 118 with half-metallic character.
watch_item: Stability is based on τ-tolerance-factor predictions, so experimental synthesis feasibility and real-world phase stability may still differ for some candidates.
paper_title: Spin-Polarized Electronic Structure and Chemical Bonding Data for 2,500+ Halide Double Perovskites
